# Rust AI Commerce

> An MIT-licensed Rust ecommerce prototype for merchant-approved AI operations,
> local LLMs, partial MCP/UCP adapters and selected original Shopware behavior ports.

## Start
- [Overview](https://sthamann.github.io/rust-ai-commerce/)
- [Measured local performance](https://sthamann.github.io/rust-ai-commerce/benchmarks.html)
- [Local quickstart](https://sthamann.github.io/rust-ai-commerce/quickstart.html)
- [Local MCP bridge](https://sthamann.github.io/rust-ai-commerce/mcp.html)
- [Shopware behavior ports](https://sthamann.github.io/rust-ai-commerce/shopware.html)

## Original documentation
- [Repository](https://github.com/sthamann/rust-ai-commerce)
- [Feature matrix](https://github.com/sthamann/rust-ai-commerce/blob/main/docs/shopware-parity.md)
- [Recorded verification](https://github.com/sthamann/rust-ai-commerce/blob/main/docs/verification.json)
- [Security and SaaS boundaries](https://github.com/sthamann/rust-ai-commerce/blob/main/docs/security.md)

## Limits
Working prototype. Payments simulated/manual/Sandbox; no real money is charged.
Not a full Shopware replacement or validated production SaaS.
MCP/UCP are partial bindings. Hosted accounts and production OAuth are not configured.
Live cloud quality, production scale and causal sales uplift are unverified.
